name: jetlinks-ai-component
description: Generate JetLinks visualization designer remote component files for agent calls, especially component.vue and config.mjs.

routing.summary: Generate a simple JetLinks visualization remote component that follows the required component.vue and config.mjs format.
examples: 生成一个大屏柱状图组件
创建一个 AI 可视化组件

quality_template: component.vue must use Options API, never <script setup>.
Template components must be registered explicitly in components.
setup() must return every value used by the template.
ConfigProps.componentProps.style must include x, y, width, and height.
Only allowed runtime imports may be used.

objective.description: What the component should show or accomplish.

resource_id.description: Visualization resource id, for example ai_basicBar_v1.

display_name.description: Human-readable component name shown in the designer.

default_data.description: Default static data used by dataSourceProps.defaultValue.
